name: 3D Forest Inventory (3DFin)
description: Automatic dendrometry and forest inventory for terrestrial point clouds

references.text: Laino, D., Cabo, C., Prendes, C., Janvier, R., Ordonez, C., Nikonovas, T., Doerr, S., & Santin, C. (2024). 3DFin: a software for automated 3D forest inventories from terrestrial point clouds. Forestry: An International Journal of Forest Research.
